that the partners of this surgery are fully aware and happy about the predatory parking charges they are inflicting on people in a cost of living crisis. I visited Kippax for the first time to pick up a takeaway on a dark evening and found what I thought was a reasonable place to park - it was late after all and the building in front (unbeknownst to me, a doctors surgery was clearly shut). It just looked like a normal shared car park, and I was nipping into the coop facing as well the surgery so I thought nothing at all of it.

Until I got a letter charging me £60 because apparently the doctors surgery is enforcing a 24 hour ban on parking in front of the surgery.
